title: The diplomatic 'settle a quarrel' will-check option offered near-identical phrasing both times two companions 'both looked at me' ('call the door's fate a draw' at the Vale barrow, 'call it a draw between them' at the Hundred Gallery) — functional and welcome both times, but repetitive enough to feel like reused text rather than a bespoke line for each quarrel.
where: The Empty Seat (Vale) / The Hundred Gallery — Quiet (Iron Downs)
